records.title: Domestic Production of Fertilizers
details:
a to d: The overall progress of the TFL project as on 28.02.2026 is 71.24%.
Recently, the Union Cabinet has approved the proposal for setting up of a new
Brownfield Ammonia-Urea Complex of 12.7 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT) annual
capacity of Urea production within the existing premises of Brahmaputra Valley
Fertilizer Corporation Limited (BVFCL), Namrup, Assam namely Assam Valley
Fertilizer & Chemicals Company Ltd. (AVFCCL). Currently both are under
execution.

records.title: EMRS In Kandhamal District of Odisha
details: b: In Kandamal District, out of 12 blocks, a total of 10 EMRSs have been sanctioned. 2 EMRSs are functional. Construction of buildings has been completed for 2 EMRSs, work is in progress at 5 locations, and 3 locations are currently at the pre-construction stage.

records.title: Inclusion of Gopalpur-Rairakhol Railway Line
details: a to f: The survey work & preparation of DPR considering the alignment via Phulbani is taken up by ORIDL.

records.title: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs In Odisha
details: 07 Medical colleges were approved in Odisha State at Districts Balasore, Baripada, Bolangir, Koraput, Puri, Jajpur and Kalahandi.

records.title: Modernization of Cooperative Banks and PACS
details: a: Under the said project, a proposal has been received from the State Government of Odisha, recently.

records.title: Aviation Infrastructure in Odhisha
details: Part (a) & (b); The development work at Rangeilunda is currently underway by the State Government. The development of the Amarda and Rairangpur airports is currently in the planning stage.

records.title: PROTECTION OF ESSENTIAL MINERALS.
details: Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) for 21 blocks of critical minerals are currently under process.
